title: Flashcards
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Flashcards
learningObjectives: Recall the English meaning of a Tagalog word before revealing it with the Show Definition button
Explain how the active-recall pattern of hiding the definition until the learner commits to an answer strengthens retention
Trace how the app loads word pairs from wordlist.json and renders the current card's front and back
Identify the separation between the word data in wordlist.json and the display logic in app.js, and explain why that separation lets the deck be swapped without code changes
Design a decomposition of a flashcard application into data loading, card display, and navigation functions
